environment_requirements: LLM and embedding credentials/endpoints configured in YAML: llm.api_key, embedding.api_key, optional base_url fields.
Per-benchmark data/environment needed; ALFWorld package/assets, LLB db/os Docker, BCB dataset environment.

integration.style: Importable package with MemoryService, plus standalone research runners; prefer isolated environment/backend adapter.
integration.role: Future memory retrieval and reward update provider.
caveats: update_values(successes, retrieved_ids_list) booleanizes each successes element to configured success/failure reward; use update_value for continuous rewards.

retrieve_query currently documents and implements similarity-Q hybrid scoring, while retrieve_value_aware uses value-aware/epsilon-greedy path. Select explicit path; do not assume all retrieval APIs implement identical paper algorithm.
QValueUpdater uses new_q=(1-alpha)*old_q+alpha*(reward+gamma*next_max_q). Default gamma=0, so update is post-outcome reward averaging; Q is attached to a memory item, not an environment action.
Do not install the full benchmark requirements into the EvoTest core environment now.

environment_requirements: Synthetic adapters require no API, model server, GPU or EDA installation.
Real application must provide embed, agent, independent harness, distill adapters and tool environment.
State/output directories must be new; CLI refuses overwrite.

integration.style: Source-level module and main.py experiment CLI; callable adapters use module:function configuration.
integration.role: Future pass-gated procedural memory plus tool-call statistical guidance.
adapter_signatures: agent(task_document, memory_context, task_directory, session_directory, execution, hooks=None) -> dict
caveats: Before-call hook provides advisory guidance; it does not veto the already chosen call.
Only an independent verified PASS can create a new immutable procedural skill.
Native learn requires integrity-sealed, task-bound, single-use harness verdict from ChipMEM.run_harness; arbitrary boolean/string is insufficient.
Embed original task artifact, not augmented prompt/retrieved memory.

Public repository explicitly excludes paper result artifacts, raw traces, trained memories, proprietary agents/prompts and commercial tool/dataset configurations; synthetic CLI is not paper-result reproduction.
